summary: I think if the academy is to have the impact folks in this thread call for we must also rethink our scholarship. Too much effort put into defining and not doing. Publishing and p values over people.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I think if the academy is to have the impact folks in this thread call for we must also rethink our scholarship.

Too much effort put into defining and not doing.

Publishing and p values over people.
